title: GRC: Unifying Reasoning-Driven Generation, Retrieval and Compression
selection_reason: GRCはメタ潜在トークンを介して生成・埋め込み・文脈圧縮を1回のforwardで統合し、更新可能なO(1)長の潜在KVメモリとhybrid paged attentionを用いる。一次要旨はRAG推論の配置負担軽減と遅延評価を扱うが、学習方式の提案も大きいため推論時の圧縮・キャッシュ機構に注目して収録する。
instructions: Read the primary source in full. Produce a repository-quality structured research record covering problem, novelty, method, evaluation conditions, key quantitative results, limitations, implementation status, and relation to existing repository lineages. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. Follow workflow v10 fixed-slot transport; do not send completed Markdown from Scheduled Chat.
completion: Submit the complete workflow-v10 five-slot structured research record and source evidence.
